observations: body L1-L37: the proof of rule (β) refers to the second figure of p. 183.
body L1: the O of «OHW» is printed broken, like «()».
body L7: a speck stands over the R of «RL»; it is not a sign.

body L8-L12: the proportion is checked: the arcs CW and RH are cut off by the same verticals OC and OW from circles of radii CB = R and RL = cos h, so that CW : RH = R : cos h, and with CW = sin azimuth, sin azimuth = R RH / cos h.
body L13, L17, L23, L26, L29, L31, L35: the minus signs are printed as long dashes; they are set as minus signs.
body L15-L16: the name al–Battānī is divided with the long dash at the end of the line and again at the beginning of the next, as printed.

body L17-L31: the formulas are checked: with sin amplit. ortivae = R sin δ / cos φ (chapter 7) and sin differ. horiz. = sin h sin φ / cos φ (rule (α) of p. 183), rule (β) gives L26, and with the azimuth counted from the north point and R = 1 it becomes cos azimuth = (sin δ − sin h sin φ)/(cos h cos φ), the cosine rule of L34 with a = 90° − δ, b = 90° − h, c = 90° − φ. The form of Ḥabash (L23) is the negative of (β): it gives the azimuth counted towards the south.
body L26: a dot stands between «sin» and «δ» in the numerator; it is not a sign.
notes_left L2: the dash before «Quando» is the separating dash (7.7 pt).

review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
